business_summary.text: Raghav Productivity Enhancers makes silica ramming mass for induction furnaces and is expanding into tundish mass for electric arc furnaces and foundry-grade products.

call_points.text: The JV is placed where half of India's induction furnaces are, against a single plant in the West today.
RPEL will receive royalty from the JV for its manufacturing technology.
Tundish mass is pitched at about 10x the life of the tundish board it replaces, with higher margin than ramming mass.
The 2031 destination is direction only: 1 million MT ramming mass capacity, multi-location plants and no dilution.
EBITDA per tonne roughly doubled from ~₹1,245 to ~₹2,650 between FY17 and Q1FY27.
Group capacity is being raised by 120,000 MTPA to 534,000 MTPA, split between RPEL and RPSPL.
Q4 capacity utilisation was 87%; the company cites healthy customer addition and strong demand visibility.
Export growth was muted by Iran war related disruptions; exports resumed normalcy from April.
FY26 delivered ROCE of 28% and CFO of ₹37 Cr.

guidance.statement: Targeting 1 million MT of ramming mass capacity by 2031
30% capacity expansion to 5.34 lakh MTPA to be live in October 2026

status_history.evidence: Brownfield expansion on track: New capacity will be operational in Q3FY27, capacity to increase from 4,14,000 MTPA to 5,34,000 MTPA.

guidance.statement: 80:20 JV with TRL Krosaki (Nippon Steel) targeting 350,000 MTPA in East India

status_history.evidence: Incorporation and initial share subscription of the JV entity RPEL TRLK Silicatech Private Limited completed.

operating_notes.text: Recommended final dividend of ₹1.00 per share (10%) for FY 2025-26.
Group capacity is 414K MTPA, being upgraded to 534K MTPA (RPEL 144,000 to 180,000; RPSPL 270,000 to 354,000).
Q4FY26 capacity utilisation was 87%; FY26 ROCE 28% and CFO ₹37 Cr.
Domestic market share rose to 14.0% in FY2026 from 12.0% in FY2025, against a stated 30% target.
Group capacity is 4.14 lakh MTPA at 94% utilisation, expanding 30% to 5.34 lakh MTPA in October 2026.
Exports are 80 KMT, 24% of volume, to 40+ countries at 3-5X local pricing.
Outward freight from Rajasthan is ₹2,500-3,500 per MT, against ₹500-700 per MT expected from the East India JV.
Capacity utilization reached 95% on a consolidated basis in H1 FY27, driven by strong demand and scaling of new products like Tundish FerroShield.
Acquired 80% stake in RPEL TRLK Silicatech Private Limited, a JV with TRL Krosaki Refractories Limited, for ₹80,000.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹70.56 Cr (+39.3% YoY), net profit ₹15.16 Cr (+49.7% YoY).
Raghav Productivity Enhancers released an investor presentation for FY26 marking 10 years of listing.

On 10 September 2026 RPEL's investor presentation set out a 2031 plan including an 80:20 JV with TRL Krosaki (Nippon Steel) for 350,000 MTPA in East India, a 30% capacity expansion live in October 2026 and a move into tundish mass, foundries and high-purity silica.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹92.81 Cr (+46.0% YoY), net profit ₹21.63 Cr (+56.3% YoY).
Raghav Productivity reported record H1 FY27 results with revenue of ₹180 Cr and PAT of ₹41 Cr, alongside ongoing capacity expansion.
Raghav Productivity acquired an 80% stake in the newly incorporated JV entity RPEL TRLK Silicatech Private Limited in Odisha for ₹80,000.
